notes.title: Demo version of SKY
notes.content:
[h3]The game development is complete, and the gameplay and new screenshots are already available for viewing. The demo version is ready and waiting to be released. Below I will list some key dates before SKY launches. I wish you a great time![/h3]
[previewyoutube=7QAa2NC2aTE;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] June 1, 2023 - a free demo version of SKY will become available and will stay with you forever. Since this is a demo version, it is also a much reduced functionality from the full version of the game.
[*]On 19-26 June, SKY will take part in the Steam NEXT Fest.
[*] On 27 June, SKY will be released.
[/list]
[b]Your BASIC[/b]

notes.title: Hello, friends, SKY is on the Horizon.
notes.content:
[h2]The plans for the next month are as follows:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Complete game development
[*] Show the gameplay trailer
[*] Release a public free demo version
[/list]

[h3]I would also like to inform you that the game will take part in the Steam NEXT Fest on July 23, 2023.[/h3]
Also, please add my game to your wishlist. This way you will help it to get more attention and a chance to live, not just exist. 
Thank you for your attention, with love from Ukraine.

[h3]Release date June 27, 2023[/h3]

[b]Your >BASIC.[/b]
